name: Catastrophic Contagion (2022)
description: October 2022 pandemic tabletop exercise co-hosted by Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, WHO, and Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Simulated a series of pandemic scenarios involving a new pathogen (Severe Epidemic Enterovirus Respiratory Syndrome 2025) primarily affecting children, exploring emergency health governance and international response coordination.
domain: pandemic preparedness, global health emergency, pediatric health crisis
reputation: widely cited; continuation of influential JHU CHS/Gates Foundation exercise series
notes: Open access materials. Unique focus on pathogen primarily affecting children, adding ethical and political complexity dimensions absent from prior exercises in this series.

institutions: Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security
